plugins.name: use-browser
plugins.description: Claude Code controls a dedicated Chrome through CDP: open pages, click, type, screenshots, console/network error collection, multi-step scenarios (Windows, Node.js 18+)

plugins.name: vault
plugins.description: Personal knowledge vault: create unlimited topics (vault-provision), drop raw notes (vault-push), organize them into documents (vault-ingest), search, lint, and write per-topic session records linked across topics (vault-session).

plugins.name: logical
plugins.description: Logical thinking: decompose a topic into a MECE numbered tree (logical-think), then turn the numbered result into an executable folder structure of small work units (logical-tree).
